candidateDefinition: Recommendation-visible standalone or point-of-interest destination records surfaced by the frozen KAI-151 thematic candidate/exposure audit; hubs and already-sufficient records are retained for classification but are not mutated.
selectionMethod: Frozen five-duration recommendation exposure (shortOuting, halfDay, fullDay, 2d1n, 3d2n) across Tokyo, Osaka, and Fukuoka origins, filtered to the thematic signal and reviewed against destination-specific official operator, municipal, prefectural, or official tourism evidence.

records.name: Onjuku Beach

seasonMetadata.basis: Operational hours and seasonal openings do not establish a defensible four-season suitability score; unknown is preserved.

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone beach with an official municipal tourism association swimming period.

officialEvidence.authority: Onjuku Town Tourism Association official site
observations: The official page lists the 2026 beach opening period as July 18-August 23, 08:30-17:00, and describes the white sand, calm shallow Ajiro Bay shore, and three swimming beaches.

records.decisionNote: The published lifeguarded/swimming period maps to July-August; beach access outside that period is not claimed unavailable.

records.name: Shikisai-no-Oka

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone flower park with official green-season and flower-calendar evidence.

observations: The official site publishes green-season information, seasonal flower calendar links, and June-September opening hours of 08:40-17:30; current notices document flowers in bloom during July and August.

records.decisionNote: The explicit June-September green-season window is used conservatively; winter snow activities are not treated as the summer peak.

records.name: Farm Tomita

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone flower farm with a strong lavender signal, but the checked current official page does not state a recurring lavender month window.

observations: The official site provides current opening hours and flower-field/news information, but the checked page does not publish a recurring lavender peak window suitable for exact bestMonths.

records.decisionNote: Leave unknown rather than reuse an uncited lavender peak.

records.name: Yonehara Beach & Coral Reef
records.cohortReason: Standalone beach/coral POI with marine activity association but no verified official operating window in the checked evidence.

observations: The checked official national-park source establishes the broader coral-reef setting but does not provide a beach-specific seasonal operating or peak window for Yonehara.

records.name: Keramashoto National Park

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: Broad island national-park record with beaches and marine activities but no destination-wide summer month window in the checked official source.

officialEvidence.authority: Ministry of the Environment national park site
observations: The official source establishes the park, islands, and marine environment, but no single summer peak window for the whole park record was verified.

records.decisionNote: Broad park scope and variable marine conditions keep it unknown.

records.name: Aoshima Island & Devil's Washboard

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: Standalone coastal island with strong summer/beach association but no verified official month window in the checked evidence.

observations: The checked official tourism material establishes Aoshima as a coastal scenic island, but does not provide a recurring summer operating or peak window for this card.

records.decisionNote: Do not infer months from subtropical identity alone.
